source.title: Preparatory Survey for Cavite Industrial Area Flood Risk Management Project — Final Report, Volume 1: Summary
source.publisher: Japan International Cooperation Agency; CTI Engineering International Co., Ltd.; Nippon Koei Co., Ltd.
source.surveyTextLocation: Volume 1, printed page S-140 (PDF page 169), Table 18.2, flora/fauna/biodiversity summary
source.detailReference: The summary points to Section 4.1 of Volume 3; those tables were not located. A separate JICA-hosted project EIA contains an eight-fish/three-invertebrate 2016 matrix at four estuarine stations, including Maalimango River mouth, but an explicit link to the Volume 1 aggregate was not found.

geographicScope.basis: The same summary identifies the Cavite San Juan River Basin and its mouth elsewhere, but the downstream fauna sentence does not explicitly link the fish survey to that river or a named station.

interpretation: A historical project-summary lead that reports a downstream fish survey but does not identify which watercourse or station supplied the fish summary. The common-name labels do not resolve species identities, and the project issue date is not a fish collection date.

rights.decision: Minimal attributed research facts only; do not reproduce the report table, maps, figures or text, and do not publish a species or waterbody occurrence from this summary.

limitations: The reported eight fish species are not individually named in the accessible summary.
The four common-name labels are not scientific identifications and do not establish that all eight species are represented.
The summary does not link the downstream fish survey to San Juan River, a station, or a dated reach; the broader project area includes multiple river basins and channels.
Fish sampling date, gear, identification procedure and vouchers were not available in Volume 1.
The report publication date is not an observation date, and this historical summary does not establish current presence, catchability, legality or safety.
Volume 3 is cited as the detailed source for Section 4.1, but its relevant fish tables and station details were not found in this bounded review.
Reuse terms remain unverified; no species projection or public admission is approved.

A separate official project EIA contains a 2016 four-station matrix with matching counts, but no explicit citation tying it to the JICA Volume 1 downstream survey was located. It does not establish the JICA aggregate as San Juan River evidence.
nextAction: Keep the JICA Volume 1 aggregate unassigned to San Juan because its summary names no fish river or station. The separately reviewed 2017 EIA supports a historical Station 4 locality at Maalimango River mouth only. Seek dated station-resolved evidence and permitted channel geometry for Bacoor, Cavite San Juan and Labac; retain the 2016 San Juan mouth salinity as point-specific historical context.

environmentalContext.otherSourceStatement: The report says salinity exceeded the referenced standard from the river mouth to Site S7 and foresees seawater having run up to those sites; their coordinates and exact river reaches are not given in Volume 1.
environmentalContext.interpretation: Historical site-specific water-quality evidence only. The survey window is known but the individual S1 sampling day and coordinates are not. Do not treat this as a current river-wide salinity class or as the station for the downstream fish survey.
